item.title: Sign obscured by hedgerow, 18th August
item.description:
On Dog Lane Witcombe just up from Holly Brae on the opposite side. The sign warning NOT suitable for HGVs is obscured by the hedgerow. The wide road narrows significantly and the whole of Dog Lane GL3 4UG is a narrow lane with passing places only. There are NO signs at all at the other end of the lane by the mail box. Due to overhanging trees the whole of the lane is not suitable for artic lorries yet they still come up because there are NO warning signs

item.title: Overgrown brambles on CBC land, 18th August
item.description:
At the back of 29 Sissinghurst Grove where the stream is, the brambles and weeds are pushing the fence over. I believe that the previous owner of the property requested that this area was not to be cut. The rest of the area gets cut back annually. Please could this area be cut back and included in any maintenance schedule. Also the garden shed is now leaning towards the stream as the bottom of the garden is starting to move. No rush as I know everybody is very busy. Thank you
